Game switches

GLOBAL changes the game for every player. ADMIN ONLY only changes your account. You always have access either way.

🏪
Shop GLOBALPlayers can open the Shop.
🎉
Events tab GLOBALShows the seasonal Events tab in the Shop.
🏅
Achievements GLOBALAchievement tracking for everyone.
⚔
Battle Pass GLOBALShows the Battle Pass on the menu.
🗺
Campaign GLOBALWhen off, players see a "coming soon" popup.
🎲
Random decks online GLOBALEveryone can pick a Random Deck in online rooms and Find Match. Turn it off when the game goes public.
🔨
Crafting · Court Shards GLOBALPlayers can break cards into Court Shards and craft cards (COURT → Court Forge, Deck Builder). Rates: Seasons → Crafting rates.
🏛
Trial of Courts GLOBALThe gauntlet on PLAY: one deck, seven Courts, one loss ends it. Solo vs the CPU.
🃏
Draft & Sealed GLOBALLimited play on PLAY → Single Player: open packs or draft vs 7 CPU drafters, build 40 cards, 3 wins or 2 losses. Cards are borrowed. Payout: ✎ REWARDS on its screen.
🍂
Harvest of Courts (event) GLOBALThe first limited-time event: 7 missions, 9 challenges, 13 event-only cards. Players see it on PLAY and SHOP → Events.
🎴
Every card ×4 ADMIN ONLYYou own 4 copies of every card. Nobody else is affected.

Seasons

Crafting rates GLOBALCourt Shards a card breaks for and costs to craft, per rarity; holo multipliers; Heralds; Sighted first.
Battle Pass season GLOBALStart or end the current season for everyone.
Battle Pass defaults GLOBALPut the Battle Pass back to its default setup.
Campaign defaults GLOBALPut the campaign back to its default chapters.

Pop-upsWhere choices appear during a match

Status Effect Animations
Auras on afflicted cards and a quick effect each turn. The status icons always show.
Help
Menu Tips
A short tip from Virora the first time you open each screen (for newer players). The Court Tour is under OPTIONS → Tutorial.
Keyword Tips
Keywords like Freeze or Guardian are underlined in Card Info and the Battle Log. Hover one (tap on a phone) to see what it does.

How long card plays and ability banners stay up. Click any moment to speed it up.
